answer_1.quote: When conversing with a human user, an opendomain dialogue system is expected to generate human-like responses ... We use two public dialogue datasets ... DailyDialog and OpenSubtitles ... The generated responses are evaluated ...

answer_2.quote: We use ppl , response length and distinct-n to evaluate the diversity of generated responses. We also use BLEU to evaluate the degree of the word‑overlap between generated responses and ground truth. Moreover, we introduce the coherence to assess the coherence between contexts and generated responses.

answer_4.quote: Three annotators are invited to rank the generated responses with respect to three aspects: diversity, relevance and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Rank the generated responses on diversity, relevance and fluency; ties are allowed.
